title: CdiffCladeML: Two-stage multilocus sequence typing clade classifier for Clostridioides difficile
description: CdiffCladeML (v1.0.0) is a two-stage supervised and allele-distance classifier for seven-locus Clostridioides difficile MLST allele profiles, resolving classical clades 1-5 via a one-hot-encoded Random Forest and routing divergent cryptic Clostridioides lineages via an allele- and profile-distance gate.
